visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with styled brown hair, wearing a black textured pinstripe blazer over a black inner shirt, speaks directly to the camera in a professional studio setting. A bright yellow diabolo graphic with sticks and string floats near the bottom center of the frame against a backdrop of posters and blurred equipment. (2) The screen splits horizontally; the upper portion displays a news broadcast from PTS News featuring a female anchor and a report on a diabolo coach's espionage trial, while the lower portion maintains the shot of the speaker. A screenshot of a web article follows, detailing the 10.5-year prison sentence of the defendant. (3) Close-up footage shows a green and yellow diabolo being spun rapidly on a white string, followed by a cut to a close-up of two individuals in business suits shaking hands outdoors to symbolize a deal or recruitment. A wooden gavel is shown striking its base in the top half of a split screen, representing legal judgment, while text overlays detail financial figures of over 5.7 million NTD. (4) A blue and green bar chart appears, illustrating the sharp increase in national security cases from 16 in 2021 to 64 in 2024. The speaker then presents a screen recording of the Investigation Bureau's website and an illustrated poster for an event titled 'National Security in Motion'. The video concludes with the man gesturing towards a large yellow call-to-action text overlay pointing downward at the information bar.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a clear, professional male voice narration delivered at a moderate conversational pace. A high-energy, upbeat electronic background music track with a steady synthesizer rhythm accompanies the speech. The vocals are centered and prominent, exhibiting high articulation clarity and a neutral to serious narrative tone consistent with news commentary. (2) A sharp, synthesized whooshing sound effect marks the transition as the diabolo footage appears, blending with the ongoing rhythmic BGM. The speaker continues without interruption, his volume level slightly higher than the instrumental layer to ensure message clarity. (3) A loud, percussive thud sound effect, mimicking a gavel strike, coincides with the visual split screen showing legal judgment. The background music remains constant in tempo and volume, providing a energetic foundation for the factual delivery regarding legal penalties. (4) Digital UI click and notification-style sound effects are layered in as screen recordings of a website and interactive quiz are shown. The narration rises slightly in pitch during the promotion of prizes like the iPhone 17. The track concludes with the voice and music ending simultaneously with no digital artifacts.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to raise awareness about national security threats in Taiwan by using a high-profile diabolo coach espionage case as an example. It transitions from informative news commentary to a call-to-action, promoting an educational quiz event by the Investigation Bureau with tangible rewards to encourage public engagement with counter-espionage efforts.
